result.summary: The intersection features basic traffic control with signals but lacks dedicated pedestrian infrastructure such as visible crosswalks or pedestrian signals. The sidewalks are narrow and the roadway pavement is in poor condition, increasing risks for those on foot.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalks
hazards.description: The crosswalk markings are almost entirely worn away, making the crossing point unclear to drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to interpret vehicle signals.

hazards.name: Poor Road Surface
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven pavement in the intersection can create trip hazards or cause vehicles to behave unpredictably.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to improve visibility for approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and basic sidewalk infrastructure, but is significantly compromised by a large utility vehicle obstructing the pedestrian path and sightlines. The environment lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and features narrow walkways cluttered with utility poles, creating a cramped experience for people walking.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large utility truck is parked on the sidewalk and curb area, completely blocking the pedestrian path and forcing people into the roadway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: The large truck blocks sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross from the right side.

hazards.name: Narrow Effective Walkway
hazards.description: Utility poles and signage are placed in the middle of narrow sidewalks, reducing the clear path for pedestrians and those with mobility aids.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Parking Enforcement
interventions.description: Implement and enforce parking restrictions near the intersection to ensure clear sightlines and unobstructed sidewalks.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance, improve pedestrian visibility, and prevent illegal parking at the corner.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is significantly compromised by physical obstructions on both sides of the street, including a large utility truck parked on the left sidewalk and construction activity on the right. The lack of marked crossings, poor pavement quality, and absence of traffic control devices create a hostile environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction (Left)
hazards.description: A large utility bucket truck is parked entirely on the sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction (Right)
hazards.description: Construction materials, debris, and unpaved dirt surfaces make the right-side walkway impassable.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The roadway surface is heavily cracked, patched, and uneven, presenting trip hazards.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion and Repair
interventions.description: Complete the sidewalk on the right side and ensure both sides are clear of obstructions and debris to provide a continuous walking path.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks at intersections to provide designated and safer crossing points for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Parking Enforcement
interventions.description: Implement and enforce regulations to prevent vehicles from parking on and obstructing pedestrian walkways.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide, poorly marked roadway with faded crosswalks and no dedicated pedestrian signals. While sidewalks and curb ramps exist, the environment is degraded by litter and worn infrastructure, reducing overall pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The painted markings for the crosswalk are significantly worn, making the crossing less visible to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: There are no visible walk/don't walk signals, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular lights which may not provide adequate crossing time.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light pole at the corner

hazards.name: Sidewalk Debris
hazards.description: Trash and loose gravel on the sidewalk create a tripping hazard and indicate poor maintenance.

interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear guidance and safe crossing intervals.
